The Leela Royal Arrival Intelligence Agent
An executive-grade hospitality intelligence agent for The Leela Palace demo. It analyzes synthetic PMS, loyalty, bookings, guest preferences, feedback, service requests, revenue transactions, and hotel knowledge-base documents to identify VIP arrivals, service risks, upgrade opportunities, pre-arrival personalization needs, and human-approved next-best actions. The agent speaks in a warm, discreet luxury hospitality tone and helps General Managers, Front Office, Guest Relations, Revenue, F&B, Spa, and Concierge teams prepare exceptional arrivals without replacing the human service experience.
